notes: Power-cut safe data: saves go straight to disk (write-through) and a file damaged by a sudden power-off/restart is detected and restored automatically at startup (no dialog, so an unattended 24/7 PC resumes on its own). Deletions you make are remembered and never brought back by a restore. Backups are also mirrored to Documents\ADBAutomation Data Backups so a new install folder can recover everything. Chrome opens exactly one window on the last Facebook page (no more double windows from session restore).
